# Maximize fills the app viewport and stops an edge-band pane at half of it: the presentation should fill the dock host, inset by a gap, with a shadow

Sub-issue of #13158 (dock layouts). Reported by the operator on the Workstation, 2026-09-02 ~16:20Z: maximizing the Queues pane fills half the screen while maximizing other items fills it all; and the intent, stated with it: maximize should fill the workspace (not the viewport), with a slight gap and a box-shadow. #18027 (the FLIP flash) is the neighbour and does not cover this.

## Measured (served Workstation, 1280×720 CSS px, DPR 2)

- `Neo.dashboard.dock.Workspace#measureDockMaximizeRect` measures the **workspace root** (`me.id`), which on the Workstation is the whole app view: `{x: 0, y: 0, w: 1239, h: 720}` — the viewport, tour bar and status bar included. The dock host (`getDockHost()`, `.neo-dashboard-dock-query-host`) is `{x: 0, y: 98, w: 1239, h: 622}`.
- Maximizing the center node `right-top-tabs` (Metrics) writes `left: 0; top: 0; width: 1239px; height: 720px` and renders exactly that: the app viewport.
- Maximizing the edge-band node `left-tabs` (Queues) writes the same inline rect but renders **640 × 720** — half the viewport — because `.neo-dashboard-dock-edge-band` keeps `max-inline-size: var(--dock-edge-band-left-max-inline-size, var(--dock-edge-band-max-inline-size, 50%))` (and its min/inline-size) under `.neo-dock-maximized`; a `max-*` constraint applies to an inline width too. Center nodes carry no such cap, which is the asymmetry the operator saw.
- The containing block is the viewport for both (the maximized node is `position: fixed`; the dock host's `container-type: size` does not capture it in Chrome), so the written rect is in viewport coordinates.

## The Fix

1. **Fill the dock host.** `measureDockMaximizeRect` measures `getDockHost()` (fallback: the workspace root when no host is mounted). The resize re-measure follows the same source.
2. **Gap and shadow as tokens on `.neo-dashboard`**, owned by the paint contract, never a literal in the worker: `--dock-maximize-gap` (engine default a slight inset) and `--dock-maximize-shadow` (a neutral soft shadow, like the drop chips'). The worker writes the rect as `calc()` against the gap token — `left: calc(<x>px + var(--dock-maximize-gap))`, `width: calc(<w>px - 2 * var(--dock-maximize-gap))`, likewise top/height — so the token resolves in CSS and a consumer tunes it without touching the engine; the FLIP still measures the DOM and is unaffected.
3. **Lift the band caps under maximize:** `.neo-dashboard-dock-edge-band.neo-dock-maximized` clears `max-inline-size` / `max-block-size` / `min-*` for the maximized node only, so an edge-band pane maximizes to the same rect as a center pane.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 Component (`DockMaximize.spec.mjs`, the fixture has a right edge band): a maximized center node's rect equals the dock host's rect inset by the gap on every side, not the viewport; red on `dev` (today it equals the workspace root).
- [ ] AC-2 Component: a maximized edge-band node (`edge-tabs`) renders the same rect as the center node; red on `dev` (today it stops at half).
- [ ] AC-3 Component: the maximized node carries the shadow token's value and no residual `max-inline-size`; Escape restores as before.
- [ ] AC-4 The workspace resize re-measure keeps the host-based rect (existing arm stays green); the FLIP arms and the rest of `component/dashboard` + `unit/dashboard` stay green.
- [ ] AC-5 The Workstation by eye: Queues and Metrics maximize to the same inset panel above the dock area, tour bar and status bar still visible, both themes.

## Out of Scope

- The FLIP flash (#18027).
- A consumer-tuned gap per app (the tokens make it possible; the Workstation keeps the engine default unless the operator asks).

Sweep 16:20Z before filing: live latest-open (#18027 is the only maximize ticket, on the FLIP flash), A2A (no claim), Knowledge Base (no leaf).
